title: ::: K-IG 교육 영어듣기훈련프로그램 | 기초2 | 제 001 회 강의 :::
label: [ K-IG 교육 Reading 119 ]

blocks.text: Babies experience anxiety when they see strangers. Children aged 2 through 6 show anxiety about things not based in reality such as ghosts. Kids aged 7 through 12 often fear real situation that may happen to them, such as injuries or accidents. As a child grows, fears my disappear. For example, a child who couldn't sleep with the light off at age 5 may enjoy ghost story years later. And some fears may extend only to one kind, as in the example of the child who wants to pet a lion at the zoo but wouldn't dream of putting the neighbor's dog.

readingSentences.english: Babies experience anxiety when they see strangers.
Children aged 2 through 6 show anxiety about things not based in reality such as ghosts.
readingSentences.korean: 2~6세의 애들은 귀신과 같은 현실에 근거하지 않은 것들에 대해 걱정을 한다.

readingSentences.english: Kids aged 7 through 12 often fear real situation that may happen to them, such as injuries or accidents.
readingSentences.korean: 7~12세의 애들은 부상이나 사고와 같은 그들에게 일어날 수 있는 실재적인 상황들에 대해 종종 두려워한다.

readingSentences.english: As a child grows, fears my disappear.
For example, a child who couldn't sleep with the light off at age 5 may enjoy ghost story years later.
readingSentences.korean: 예를 들면, 5세 때에 불을 끄고는 잠을 자지 못하던 애가 1년 후면 귀신 예기를 즐길 수도 있다.

readingSentences.english: And some fears may extend only to one kind, as in the example of the child who wants to pet a lion at the zoo but wouldn't dream of putting the neighbor's dog.
readingSentences.korean: 그리고 어떤 공포는, 동물원의 사자를 또닥거리길 원하지만 옆집 개를 만져 볼 엄두도 내지 못하는 어린애의 예에서처럼, 한가지 종류에 연장되기도 한다.
